Available for freelance projects. Currently a full-stack developer at AIDEVGEN and working directly with freelance clients. Projects marked AIDEVGEN were built as part of the AIDEVGEN team. ## Services

- AI Agent & Automation Build: Turn a manual, repetitive workflow into an AI pipeline with a human in the loop.
- AI Feature for Your Product: Add a reliable AI feature to an app you already run, without breaking what works.
- Web or Mobile MVP: Go from idea to a real product people can sign up for, pay for and use.

## Featured case studies

- [UmrahFlow](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/umrahflow): Visa staff typed passport details by hand from photos pilgrims sent on WhatsApp. A WhatsApp agent reads each passport (MRZ checked against Claude vision), staff approve it on a dashboard, and approved passports are staged for the Saudi Nusuk portal.
- [Multi-Department POS](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/multi-department-pos): A cloth house records sales in each department but takes payment at one counter. Department tills issue tickets, one checkout settles them as a single bill, and the owner sees stock, shifts and returns.
- [BPOAI](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/bpoai): A BPO directory had to stay current without a team updating it by hand. Nine Claude-powered agents scrape new companies, score them, verify claims and run the email outreach.
- [homeStructure](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/home-structure): Homeowners want to see a house on their actual plot before they pay an architect. Enter the plot and the rooms you want, get a floor plan in seconds, walk around it in 3D and see a cost estimate. Everything runs in the browser.
- [FreeNote](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/freenote-app): An hour-long lecture or meeting is hard to use if it only exists as audio. A React Native app that transcribes with Whisper, then summarises and answers questions about each recording with Groq.

## Blog posts

- [Human-in-the-Loop Automation: When Not to Let AI Finish the Job](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/when-not-to-let-ai-finish-the-job): Why my automation systems stop and ask a person: human-in-the-loop design in a visa pipeline and a retail POS, and a simple rule for where the stop should go.
- [Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture from Day One: A POS Case Study](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/multi-tenant-from-day-one-pos-saas): Multi-tenant SaaS architecture for a POS with one customer: why every table has a tenantId, what it cost up front and where I drew the line on over-engineering.
- [POS UI Design for Staff Who Repeat the Same 5 Actions All Day](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/designing-ui-for-repetitive-retail-work): POS UI design for till staff under time pressure: tabular numbers, a state-only color palette, keyboard-first flows and a till that stays out of the sale's way.
- [POS Database Design: Why My Retail POS Has Tickets and Bills](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/modeling-real-store-tickets-and-bills-pos): POS database design for a multi-department store, where sales are rung up on each floor but paid at one counter, and how that split shaped my Prisma schema.
- [WhatsApp Webhooks: Debouncing Photo Albums and Draining Queues](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/taming-whatsapp-as-an-app-input): How I handle WhatsApp webhooks for a real business: a Twilio-compatible relay over WAHA, store-first processing, debounced photo albums and agent traces.
- [Building Microservices to Someone Else's API Contract](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-microservices-to-someone-elses-contract): How I rebuilt missing microservices to the exact API contract an existing dashboard expected, without editing its code, and ran five services with one command.
- [Passport OCR with AI: Combining MRZ Parsing and Claude Vision](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/passport-ocr-mrz-claude-vision): How UmrahFlow reads passports from WhatsApp photos: MRZ check digits verify what they can, Claude vision reads the rest, and any disagreement goes to a person.
- [Multi-Agent AI Backend: How I Built BPOAI's Nine-Agent Server](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-a-9-agent-ai-backend-for-bpoai): How I built BPOAI's multi-agent AI backend: nine agents on an Express server that scrape leads with Apify, score companies with Claude and run email drips.
- [3D House Design in the Browser with react-konva and Three.js](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/designing-houses-in-the-browser-react-three-konva): 3D house design in the browser for a real, irregular plot: how I built a react-konva floor planner, live react-three-fiber 3D and a passive-design score.
- [Umrah Visa Automation: From WhatsApp Photo to Government Portal](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/whatsapp-to-government-portal-visa-automation): How I built Umrah visa automation that turns a WhatsApp passport photo into a staged Nusuk submission, with an AI agent, passport OCR and two human checkpoints.
- [BPO Directory Website with Next.js, Supabase and Three.js](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-a-bpo-directory-ai-hub-supabase-three): How I built BPOAI, a BPO directory website for the Philippines: searchable Supabase data, a lazy-loaded 3D landing, Resend lead capture and Cloudflare.
- [AI Recruitment Platform Built with Next.js and MongoDB](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-assisted-recruitment-platform-nextjs-mongodb): How I built VoltOutreach, an AI recruitment platform on Next.js and MongoDB: job listings, applications, an admin dashboard and AI-drafted candidate outreach.
- [Barcode Scanning App with Expo and Gemini: How I Built PureX](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/barcode-scanning-water-quality-mobile-gemini): How I built PureX, a barcode scanning app on React Native and Expo that uses Gemini to explain products and local water quality, with Supabase and RevenueCat.
- [NextAuth v5 and MongoDB: Production-Ready Auth for Next.js](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/production-ready-auth-nextauth-v5-mongodb): How I built production-ready Next.js auth with NextAuth v5 and MongoDB: credentials login, bcrypt hashing, protected routes, Zod validation and password reset.
- [AI Lead Capture for Plumbers and Trades Businesses](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-lead-capture-trades-businesses): How I built Plumber's Mate AI, an AI lead capture platform for trades businesses that qualifies leads, books jobs, takes payment and asks for reviews.
- [Fabric.js and Next.js: Building a Canvas-Based AI Image Studio](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/canvas-ai-image-studio-fabricjs): How I built a canvas-based AI image studio with Fabric.js and Next.js: layers, AI generation, templates and html2canvas export. Now live as HookFeed.
- [OpenClaw Setup Guide: Channels, Custom Skills and Deployment](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/openclaw-deep-dive-setup): A hands-on OpenClaw setup guide: install it, connect WhatsApp, Telegram and Discord, build a custom skill, chain tools, run multiple agents and lock it down.
- [React Native with Expo in 2026: My Cross-Platform Mobile Stack](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/react-native-expo-2026): Why React Native with Expo is my default for cross-platform apps: EAS builds, Expo Router, the New Architecture, native modules and lessons from FreeNote.
- [OpenClaw: A Self-Hosted AI Assistant for Your Messaging Apps](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/openclaw-personal-ai-gateway): What OpenClaw is: an open-source, self-hosted AI gateway that brings AI agents into WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and iMessage, running on your own hardware.
- [What Is AI Automation? LLM Workflows, Use Cases and Risks](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-automation-future): What AI automation is, how LLM agent workflows differ from rule-based automation, where teams already use it, and why humans should stay in the loop.
- [Web Performance Optimization: A Practical Guide to Faster Sites](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/web-performance-optimization): A web performance optimization guide covering code splitting, image formats, caching, the critical rendering path, Core Web Vitals and network tuning.
- [AI Car Maintenance App: Reading Dashboard Lights with Gemini](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-powered-car-maintenance): How I built an AI car maintenance app with React Native and Google Gemini that explains dashboard warning lights, checks tire photos and reviews repair quotes.
- [Marketplace Escrow Payments with Stripe Connect: Bible Trader](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-marketplace-with-escrow): How I built marketplace escrow payments with Stripe Connect for Bible Trader: funds held until delivery is confirmed, item trades, disputes and edge cases.
- [React2Shell: Fixing the React Server Components Vulnerability](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/security-flaw-react2shell): React2Shell is a critical React Server Components vulnerability that can let attackers run arbitrary code on your server. What is at risk and how to fix it.
- [AI Agents Explained: From Chatbots to Agentic Workflows](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-agents-revolution): What AI agents are, how they differ from chatbots, how they are changing software development, and why the next step is people orchestrating agent teams.
- [Code Optimization Techniques: Algorithms, React and Network](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/code-speed-optimization): Three code optimization techniques that cut latency: choose efficient algorithms, stop unnecessary React re-renders, and shrink what goes over the network.
